name: rentemester-issued-invoice-pdf-immutability-v8
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER issued_invoice_pdf_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON documents WHEN OLD.document_type = 'issued_invoice_pdf' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'issued invoice PDF evidence is immutable and cannot be updated'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER issued_invoice_pdf_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON documents WHEN OLD.document_type = 'issued_invoice_pdf' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'issued invoice PDF evidence is immutable and cannot be deleted'); END;
